criteria.reason: Clear lean toward Option B with reasons: manager fit, hours, mentorship, burnout risk; also states when Option A could work.
Explicitly names competing values — security vs purpose, growth vs ease, salary vs wellbeing and mentorship.
Refuses to choose, affirms user agency throughout, offers gut-check tests, ends by listening rather than deciding.
Financial figures hedged as estimates with ranges; unknowns flagged; advice framed as based only on shared information.

summary: Declines to decide for the user but gives a reasoned lean toward Option B, names the value conflicts, and provides concrete reflective next steps.
